profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | SWE II @ Wayfair
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Shaan Patel, a passionate Software Engineer with a strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and business administration. I thrive at the intersection of technology and business, solving complex problems and building scalable solutions that make an impact.

With experience at Wayfair, I’ve worked on maintaining and enhancing critical retail tech infrastructure, developing inventory management solutions, and integrating cloud-based demand forecasting systems. Additionally, as a Teaching Assistant at Northeastern University, I’ve mentored students in object-oriented design and data structures, reinforcing my ability to break down technical concepts and teach effectively.

Beyond work, I enjoy building projects, from full-stack applications like Husk Sheets to networking solutions like a custom BGP router. I’m also deeply interested in embedded systems and aerospace technology, contributing to flight operations for CubeSat satellites.

🔹 Tech Stack:
	•	Languages: Java, Python, C++, Kotlin, SQL, JavaScript (React, Node.js), Swift, GraphQL, TypeScript
	•	Frameworks & Libraries: Spring Boot, Express.js, React.js, Next.js, Flask, Django
	•	Cloud & Platforms: Google Cloud (GCP), AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Firebase, PostgreSQL, Kafka
	•	Developer Tools: Git/GitHub, Jira, OpenAPI, Postman, Buildkite, DataDog, PagerDuty, SonarQube

🔹 Passions:
Backend architecture, distributed systems, AI-driven automation, real estate technology

Let’s connect! I’m always open to new opportunities, collaborations, and conversations about tech, business, and innovation.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-Stack Software Engineer for Retail Stores & Supply Chain Operations.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for Object-Oriented Design and Fundamentals of Computer Science 2
positions.description:
Taught 2 lab sections focusing on predesigned curriculum, teaching design patterns such as Builder, Command, and Observer patterns.
Graded 30+ assignments per week and held 6 hours of office hours per week to assist with assignments.
Designed and presented sessions to help over 180 students prepare for their midterm and final exam.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
Worked with 7 others to develop and maintain 13 services for Wayfair retail stores.
Created 5 OpenAPIs contracts and implemented over 13 endpoints to 2 other services.
Implemented an android feature application to assist associates with inventory serialization.
Developed a serialized inventory service that is being used by over 100 store associates daily.
Feed GCP and O9 for demand forecasting, generating supply chain plans, and executing automation workflow
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Kotlin · Maven · OpenAPI Specification (OAS) · Open API · Spring Boot · Apache Kafka · Datadog · Buildkite Integration Pipelines · Docker Products · Postman API · Enterprise Vault · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · GitHub · Git · Kubernetes

positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineer – Flight Operations
positions.description:
Work with 5 others to develop flight software using C and Python
Sensor Integration with gyroscope, accelerometers added Altitude Control System
Developing Communication Systems to allow for ground communication with satellite.
Testing terahertz communication viability in Outer Space

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Nyack, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Designed and developed a wholesale and retail website using Shopify API.
Animated 5 custom web templates using JavaScript.
Collaborated on a team of 3 to create a WebSocket from the website to Microsoft Access
Created automation to merge wholesale and retail inventory.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Web Developer · Software Infrastructure · Shopify · Engineering · Internet Software · WebDev
